name: ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect (arXiv:2403.03853)
notes: arXiv:2403.03853. ShortGPT: Layers in Large Language Models are More Redundant Than You Expect. By Xin Men et al. (Microsoft). Submitted 2024-03-06. Shows that layers in LLMs are more redundant than expected, enabling layer skipping for efficiency.
